target.title: fix(audit): audit filters select wrong intervals when dates are invalid
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators querying `openclaw audit` could receive records outside the intended time window when `--after` or `--before` contained an impossible ISO calendar date, such as February 30.

## Why This Change Was Made

Audit filters now use the existing strict absolute-time parser to validate ISO calendar dates before accepting the parsed timestamp. The command retains the existing local-time interpretation for ISO date-times without an explicit zone.

## User Impact

Operators receive an immediate validation error for impossible audit filter dates instead of silently querying a shifted interval. Valid leap-day and timezone-less timestamps keep their existing behavior.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: impossible ISO calendar dates are rejected by the audit CLI before any Gateway request, while valid timezone-less audit filters still reach `audit.list` with the established local-time timestamp semantics.
- Current-head real CLI proof at `099fbaa9c006a7347063e1bbc9c5cbc75286be77`: ran the source-checkout CLI entry with isolated `OPENCLAW_HOME`, `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, and a local loopback Gateway WebSocket responder.

```text
$ node --import tsx src/entry.ts audit --after 2026-02-30T00:00:00Z --json --limit 1
exit=1
stderr:
Error: --after must be an ISO timestamp or Unix milliseconds.

$ node --import tsx src/entry.ts audit --after 2026-07-01T00:00:00 --json --limit 1
exit=0
stdout:
{
  "events": [
    {
      "id": "proof-event-1",
      "occurredAt": 1782864000000,
      "kind": "agent_run",
      "status": "succeeded",
      "agentId": "main",
      "sessionKey": "agent:main:main",
      "runId": "proof-run",
      "action": "proof"
    }
  ]
}

GATEWAY_AUDIT_LIST_CALLS=1
audit.list[0].params={"limit":1,"after":1782835200000}
```

- Focused regression proof at `099fbaa9c006a7347063e1bbc9c5cbc75286be77`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/audit.test.ts` passed (4 tests).
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\\skills\\autoreview\\scripts\\autoreview --mode local` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
